{{Top|leg}}
'''Project Omega''' was experiment by [[Rezi Soresh]] to create the perfect [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. [[X-1 (assassin)|X-1]], [[X-2]], [[X-3]], [[X-4]], [[X-5]], [[X-6]] and [[X-7]] were the participants in the program, of which X-7 was victorious and earned the right of being Soresh's personal assassin. Soresh combined a concoction of chemical serums and [[Torture/Legends|torture]] to break down a man's resistance and erase memories. This caused them to become completely loyal to Soresh while still retaining the faculties necessary to carry out dangerous operations.<ref name="Rebel Force: Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>

By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Soresh thought he had perfected the method. He used the results of the project during his exile on a [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]] to create an army of loyal but less-effective guards. He then applied the process to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], but Skywalker was able to fake loyalty. During [[Battle of the Sixela system|Soresh's last battle]], Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to overcome the guards' programming and allowed them to escape; Soresh was [[Death/Legends|blasted]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>
